ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: An agricultural cooperative on Chongming Island adopted a new model: planting corn in spring and cauliflower in autumn; corn stalks, cauliflower leaves, and other “agricultural waste” are used to raise pigs and sheep; part of the pigs’ manure is put into the crab pond, becoming a nutrient source for plankton, while the excellent water environment created by the plankton provides conditions for the growth of shrimp and crabs; when the pond is cleared at the end of the year, the sludge at the bottom of the pond is returned to the fields as fertilizer, enhancing soil fertility. <image1> What type of agriculture does this new agricultural model described in the material belong to?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: at the top of the figure there are four production links, ①, ②, ③, and ④, connected by arrows, indicating that there are material or energy connections between different production departments; below there is a long box labeled “pond-bottom sludge,” and links such as ②, ③, and ④ have arrows pointing to the sludge below, and the sludge then flows back to the upper links through arrows, reflecting the cyclic utilization of waste or by-products. Then read the text: corn is planted in spring and cauliflower in autumn; corn stalks and cauliflower leaves are used to raise pigs and sheep; pig manure enters the crab pond, promoting the growth of plankton and improving the growth environment for shrimp and crabs; at the end of the year, pond-bottom sludge is returned to the fields as fertilizer, enhancing soil fertility. It can thus be seen that this model combines crop farming, animal husbandry, and aquaculture, and resourcefully utilizes agricultural waste, forming material circulation and a positive ecological cycle. Therefore, it belongs to ecological agriculture.

An agricultural cooperative on Chongming Island adopted a new model: planting corn in spring and cauliflower in autumn; corn stalks, cauliflower leaves, and other “agricultural waste” are used to raise pigs and sheep; part of the pigs’ manure is put into the crab pond, becoming a nutrient source for plankton, while the excellent water environment created by the plankton provides conditions for the growth of shrimp and crabs; when the pond is cleared at the end of the year, the sludge at the bottom of the pond is returned to the fields as fertilizer, enhancing soil fertility. <image1>

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：识别图中①②③④多个生产环节由箭头连接，且下方“塘底淤泥”与上方环节之间存在物质回流。再读文字：春种玉米、秋种花菜，秸秆和菜叶用来养猪羊，猪粪进入蟹塘促进浮游生物，塘底污泥年底还田增肥。最后把这些信息归纳为废弃物被重新利用、种植业—养殖业—水产业形成闭合循环的农业系统，据此判定为“生态农业”。

raw_record.original_question:
崇明岛上一家农业合作社采用了新模式：春天种玉米，秋天种花菜；玉米秆、花菜叶等“农业垃圾”用来养猪羊；猪的部分粪便投入蟹塘，成为浮游生物的营养来源，而浮游生物营造的优良水环境又为虾蟹生长提供条件；年底清塘时，塘底污泥作为肥料还田，增强土地肥力。<image1>

材料描述的这种农业新模式属于什么农业类型？
